item.title: Narjes Noureddine
item.description: Narjes Noureddine is an award-winning calligrapher who specializes in classical scripts, bringing a refined and traditional aesthetic to her work.

item.title: Wissam Shawkat
item.description: Wissam Shawkat is a world-class calligrapher and designer who has developed a unique style known as Calligraformy, blending traditional forms with modern abstraction.

item.title: Majid Alyousef
item.description: Majid Alyousef is a master calligrapher and designer based in Dubai. He is globally recognized for his ability to transform the classical Thuluth script into avant-garde geometric compositions. His work is not merely decorative; it is a study of the mathematical beauty of the Arabic letterform.
